recheck.reason: The point is right (facts economics.caveat: 'the model predicts who will leave, not who can be persuaded'), but the segment's third row already separates 'are the calls worth making at all', and the persuadability/uplift lesson comes later (5-4); a ranked risk list is the honest starting fit for a fixed call budget. A visual note carries the caveat without re-recording.
